articles.title: Is Andrej Stojakovic related to former NBA player Peja? Everything to know about Illinois star
articles.standfirst: Stojakovic scored a record-setting 46 points against Duke in their home arena.
articles.summary: Stojakovic scored a record-setting 46 points against Duke in their home arena.
articles.body:
Tuesday night featured a - literally - historic performance at Cameron Indoor Stadium in Durham, North Carolina. The No. 5 North Carolina Tar Heels welcomed the No. 10 Illinois Fighting Illini and got crushed 99--78 . Losing by that much at home is one thing, but the way in which it happened was the true storyline.

Andrej Stojakovic , who alternated between a starting and bench role last season for Illinois, put together a 46-point performance in the team's win over Duke on Tuesday night. Quentin Coleman scored 27 points, and no other Illinois player reached double-digits. Stojakovic's 46 points were the most ever scored by an opponent on the road at Duke .

Andrej Stojakovic sets record for most points scored by an opponent at Duke

Stojakovic's previous career-high was 37 points , which he put up against Stanford during the second round of the 2025 ACC Tournament , when he was a member of the California Golden Bears . Stojakovic has taken a big step forward in his development here in his senior season, now that more of the offensive load is on his plate.

For those NBA fans who remember his last name, Andrej is in fact Peja Stojakovic's son . Peja was one of the best shooters in NBA history, and made three straights All-Star teams as a member of the Sacramento Kings . He won the 2011 NBA Championship with the Dallas Mavericks , in his final season in the league.

Andrej is a different player than his father, relying more on his slashing ability and adeptness finishing at the rim . But this season so far, he's shooting 37.5% from three-point range , which is a big step up from his past three seasons. The sky appears to be the limit for Andrej as he gets ready for the NBA jump next year.

articles.title: Deion Sanders’ daughter opens up emotionally about living with a lifelong condition: “I wish I was just normal”
articles.standfirst: The Hall of Famer's youngest daughter has had diabetes since she was thirteen
articles.summary: The Hall of Famer's youngest daughter has had diabetes since she was thirteen
articles.body:
The 2026 NCAA football season for the Colorado Buffaloes has unfolded with far less national fanfare than the chaotic, celebrity-filled circus that defined the program’s earlier years. Sitting at a 4-6 record (2-5 in Big 12 play) with just two regular-season games remaining against Cincinnati and UCF, head coach Deion Sanders has already surpassed last year’s dismal 3-9 finish.

Yet, despite selling out their season ticket allotment in Boulder before the campaign even kicked off, the Buffaloes have largely faded into national irrelevance as the early-era hype continues to cool down. Away from the gridiron spotlight in Boulder, however, Sanders’ youngest daughter, Shelomi Sanders , just captured widespread attention with a deeply personal and emotional revelation about her own daily battles.

Shelomi Sanders Opens Up About Living With Type 1 Diabetes

A collegiate basketball guard who previously competed at the Division I level with Jackson State, Colorado, and Alabama A&M before transferring to Colorado State University Pueblo , Shelomi Sanders has spent her entire life under the glare of sports cameras.

This week the 22-year-old athlete shared a raw, heartfelt reflection on Instagram detailing her nearly decade-long struggle with Type 1 diabetes , an autoimmune condition she was first diagnosed with at age 13. “Diabetes, you came into my life when I was just 13 and nothing has been the same since, ” she wrote in the candid caption.

You’ve brought tears, frustration, and countless battles nobody sees. Some days I wish I was just normal, but what really is normal? Now I see things differently.

Her path to understanding the chronic illness began with a terrifying medical scare nine years ago. At 13, Shelomi started dropping weight rapidly, drinking nearly two gallons of water a day , and battling severe fatigue, symptoms she initially mistook for the byproduct of intense offseason workouts alongside her Hall of Fame father.

When she suddenly began vomiting and couldn’t even hold down basic cold medicine, she was rushed to the emergency room, where doctors discovered her blood sugar levels had spiked past a dangerous 600 mg/dL.

Today, balancing college athletics with round-the- clock glucose monitoring and insulin management , even while asleep, Shelomi uses her platform and an NIL partnership with Dexcom U to dismantle misconceptions about diabetes and prove to young athletes that a lifelong diagnosis does not have to limit their dreams.

articles.title: LeBron’s son Bryce James falls out of the Arizona rotation following the coach’s decision
articles.standfirst: Bryce played in three of the first four games and scored a total of only eight points.
articles.summary: Bryce played in three of the first four games and scored a total of only eight points.
articles.body:
Navigating the early stages of a collegiate basketball career at a perennial powerhouse like the Arizona Wildcats is never an easy task, and sophomore guard Bryce James is learning that reality firsthand.

Despite scouts long projecting his physical frame and long-term upside as having a higher ceiling than his older brother Bronny , who currently occupies a deep-bench role in the NBA with minimal court time, Bryce has struggled to carve out consistent minutes or signature moments in Tucson.

After redshirting without logging a single regular-season appearance as a freshman, James started Arizona’s first three contests this fall before not playing due to coach’s decision during Friday’s gritty 80-69 victory over the Auburn Tigers .

With the No. 12 Wildcats sitting at a 3-1 record , having bounced back with three consecutive wins following a season-opening loss to UCLA . head coach Tommy Lloyd now prepares his roster for its toughest test yet tonight against the powerhouse No. 3 UConn Huskies .

Bryce James Reacts to Major Arizona Recruiting News

Even while fighting to earn back his spot in Lloyd’s rotation, James remains heavily invested in the long-term trajectory of the program. Through three games played during the 2026–27 campaign, the Akron, Ohio native has averaged 2.7 points, 1.7 assists, and 1.3 steals across 12.0 minutes per contest.

Ahead of tonight’s marquee clash against UConn at the McKale Center , the Wildcats secured a massive recruiting victory when five-star Class of 2027 prospect Adan Diggs officially committed to Arizona over finalists Arkansas, Kentucky, and USC.

Ranked as the No. 1 shooting guard and a top-five overall player nationally in the 2027 cycle, the 6-foot-4 standout out of Goodyear, Arizona represents a huge backcourt addition for the future.

Bryce James wasted zero time celebrating the news, resharing the commitment graphic on his Instagram story accompanied by an enthusiastic “Yuhhhhhhh” reaction.

While adding another elite perimeter weapon means future competition for backcourt touches will only intensify next season , James is clearly embracing the team-first culture in Tucson as he works to prove he belongs on the floor for Arizona basketball right now.

articles.title: Michigan WR Andrew Marsh faces indecent exposure charge: Will he play again this season?
articles.standfirst: Marsh is listed as questionable for Saturday’s game against UCLA; Michigan has not announced a suspension
articles.summary: Marsh is listed as questionable for Saturday’s game against UCLA; Michigan has not announced a suspension
articles.body:
Michigan wide receiver Andrew Marsh is facing a misdemeanor indecent exposure charge stemming from a February incident.

Case remains pending, with an arraignment and pretrial proceedings scheduled for Dec. 2 in 14A District Court. The charge is an allegation, not a finding of guilt.

Pittsfield Township police said a food delivery driver reported the incident on Feb. 2. According to the department, she told officers that a man answered the door with a blanket around his shoulders and was unclothed underneath.

As she turned to leave, the man allegedly pulled the blanket open . Police said the customer later sent her a message calling her attractive and asking her to return. Officers identified the resident as the suspect, according to the police account.

The Washtenaw County Prosecutor’s Office authorized a misdemeanor complaint on Oct. 14. Court records cited in reports list arraignment and pretrial proceedings for Dec. 2. The University of Michigan said it had just learned of the incident and would monitor the case, but could not comment further while it is ongoing.

Will he play against UCLA?

The sophomore was listed as questionable on Michigan’s initial availability report for Saturday’s game. That designation does not establish whether the pending case affects his playing status, and the university has not announced a suspension.

JJ Buchanan, Michigan’s leading receiver in yardage, is out with a shoulder injury, making the question of who will be available at receiver especially relevant.

The Texas native leads Michigan with 48 catches through 10 games, totaling 459 yards and one touchdown. As a freshman in 2025, he recorded 45 receptions for 651 yards and four touchdowns.

If he is unavailable against UCLA , the Wolverines would be without one of their most productive pass-catchers as they head into the final stretch of the regular season.

Under Michigan law, the misdemeanor charge carries a maximum penalty of one year in jail, a fine of up to $1,000, or both . That is the statutory maximum, not a prediction of what a court would impose.

The complaint reported so far is for misdemeanor indecent exposure; no conviction has been reported.

Any team or university discipline would be a separate decision from the court case. Michigan has said it is monitoring the situation, but has not disclosed what action, if any, it may take.

No suspension has been announced, and the case’s outcome and the school’s response will shape what happens to the receiver’s season.

articles.title: Deion Sanders is accused of “playing the racism card” to keep his job in Colorado: “The oldest trick in the book”
articles.standfirst: Whitlock challenges Sanders' claims as police records reveal multiple harassment incidents
articles.summary: Whitlock challenges Sanders' claims as police records reveal multiple harassment incidents
articles.body:
Jason Whitlock has accused Deion Sanders of using race to protect his position as Colorado’s head coach, questioning the timing of the coach's reported harassment claims as pressure over the Buffaloes' performances grows.

Whitlock , a longtime critic of Sanders , reacted on X after The Athletic’s Justin Williams and Christopher Kamrani reported details from University of Colorado police records.

The documents contain 15 closed cases involving harassment or suspicious activity directed at Sanders , along with two cases that remain open.

“Deion is fighting tooth and nail not to get fired. This is one of the oldest tricks in the book," wrote Whitlock . "Ronny Thompson planted racist letters in his office at Ball State.

“Deion wants you to believe no one threatens Lane Kiffin, other coaches. Deion playing the race card. Predictable.”

Ball State investigated the matter involving former coach Ronny Thompson , who reported in 2007 that notes containing racial slurs and accusations had been left outside office doors, but ESPN later reported that the inquiry produced no leads.

However, Whitlock offered no evidence that Thompson had planted the messages.

The Colorado records detail incidents dating back to Sanders ’ arrival in Boulder. In May 2023, before he had coached a single game for the Buffaloes, campus officers informed him about threatening voicemails left on the football ticket office line. One message reportedly included the warning: “I’m coming after you.”

Nearly half of the closed cases were linked to one individual who sent letters containing biblical references and racist remarks.

Security personnel were told to wear gloves when handling the mail. Colorado Athletics subsequently emphasized that Sanders ' safety remained its “top priority” and that every threat was being taken seriously.

A major win shifts the focus back to football

The controversy comes as Sanders faces considerable scrutiny over Colorado’s results and his long-term future. The Buffaloes finished 3-9 last season after an impressive 9-4 campaign in 2024, when Travis Hunter and Shedeur Sanders helped transform the program's fortunes.

Replacing those stars has proved challenging, with Colorado struggling to maintain its previous momentum. Sanders entered the matchup against Houston with a 3-6 record, increasing questions about whether he could rebuild the program without the two standout players.

Colorado finally delivered a statement performance, upsetting No. 14 Houston 42-32 on November 13. The victory marked the Buffaloes’ first win over an AP top-15 opponent since defeating Oklahoma in 2007. It also improved their record to 4-6, guaranteeing an improvement over the previous season.

The financial implications of moving on from Sanders have further complicated discussions about his future. Reports indicate that he would be owed $25.5 million if Colorado fired him after the 2026 season, making a coaching change an expensive proposition for the university.

Houston's defeat doesn't eliminate the questions surrounding Sanders ' tenure, but it has eased some immediate pressure. Sanders now has an important victory to build on as Colorado looks to finish its campaign strongly and create optimism heading into another season under Coach Prime.

articles.title: Steve Sarkisian's voice breaks as he talks about Arch Manning ahead of his possible farewell at Texas' Senior Day against Arkansas
articles.standfirst: Texas head coach sends heartfelt message to Arch Manning ahead of emotional Senior Day
articles.summary: Texas head coach sends heartfelt message to Arch Manning ahead of emotional Senior Day
articles.body:
Steve Sarkisian delivered an emotional tribute to Arch Manning ahead of Texas’ Senior Day, offering a look into the strong relationship they've developed through a challenging season.

Saturday’s matchup against Arkansas could mark Manning’s final regular-season appearance at Royal-Memorial Stadium, although his participation in the ceremony doesn't necessarily mean he's leaving Austin.

“The first thing I’d say is I think they admire and appreciate his toughness, his resiliency, his grittiness, his competitive spirit,” Sarkisian said as per OnTexasFootball.

“But I also think he’s kind of a model of the heartbeat and the pulse of that locker room that we have.

“This house is really strong here, and we’ve been through some storms, Arch and I together, and when the storm dies down, we’re still standing.”

Manning entered the season carrying huge expectations, partly because of his famous football surname and partly because of his potential as a future NFL star. Texas' early success only added to the pressure, particularly after its victory over Ohio State raised hopes of a championship campaign.

However, consecutive defeats against Oklahoma and Florida showed several weaknesses. Manning faced criticism over his decision-making and consistency, while Sarkisian acknowledged that a quarterback change could become a possibility.

The Longhorns eventually recovered, putting together four consecutive victories to revive their College Football Playoff ambitions. Manning has recorded 2,198 passing yards, 19 touchdowns and 10 interceptions, completing 64.7% of his attempts.

His performance against LSU included three interceptions, but he also delivered a crucial late drive to help secure the comeback victory.

Senior Day leaves Manning’s Texas future uncertain

Texas enters Saturday's contest with an 8-2 record and a place among the leading College Football Playoff contenders. A victory over Arkansas would provide another important step before the Longhorns face Texas A&M in their regular-season finale.

Manning has confirmed that he'll participate in Senior Day, explaining that he's considered himself a senior and intends to follow through with the tradition. He also referenced center Connor Robertson , who participated in last year's ceremony before returning for another college season.

“Yeah, I mean (Robertson) did it last year. I’m doing it. I’m a senior, so I’m going to do it,” he said.

However, Manning hasn't revealed what comes next. He's insisted that his attention remains on the current campaign rather than decisions about his future.

Three possibilities remain on the table: entering the NFL Draft, returning to Texas or transferring to another program. Draft analyst Todd McShay believes another college season would benefit Manning's development, although he suggested the quarterback could still become a first-round selection if he declares.

Regardless of which direction Manning eventually chooses, Sarkisian's emotional comments shows how highly the quarterback is regarded within the Texas program.

articles.title: “Don’t go out and do anything that would embarrass me,” an LSU legend’s stern message to two Tigers stars
articles.standfirst: LSU's disappointing season has tested the patience of its former stars
articles.summary: LSU's disappointing season has tested the patience of its former stars
articles.body:
Leonard Fournette has sent a blunt warning to Lane Kiffin and Sam Leavitt ahead of LSU’s important showdown against Tennessee, making it clear that the program’s reputation is bigger than any individual.

The former Tigers running back wants both men to understand the responsibility that comes with representing one of college football’s most respected programs.

Speaking on the November 19 episode of 4th & South, Fournette didn't hold back following LSU’s heartbreaking 22-21 defeat against Texas.

“Listen, Lane Kiffin and Sam Leavitt, don’t you all go out there doing anything that embarrasses me,” Fournette said.

“Let me tell y’all this, bro. Y’all just don’t represent yourselves. Y’all represent every former Tiger that played there, right? Don’t go p***ing in y’all sheets, doing crazy, please.

“I don’t want to have to whoop no a**. This week is game week. I’m focused. I’m not talking, no s**t. Let’s stay focused. Let’s have a clean game, and let’s go, Tigers.”

The frustration comes after a damaging loss in which LSU surrendered a lead late in the game. Leavitt completed 27 of 37 passes for two touchdowns, but three interceptions proved particularly costly. Texas defensive back Jelani McDonald intercepted all three, including two passes in the end zone.

The defeat was especially frustrating because LSU had established a 21-10 advantage in the third quarter following Dilin Jones' 44-yard touchdown.

However, the Tigers couldn't find another score, allowing Texas to complete its comeback. Leavitt's decision-making will consequently be under considerable scrutiny heading into the next contest.

Kiffin and Leavitt face a hostile Tennessee test

LSU's next assignment presents another difficult challenge. The Tigers travel to Knoxville on Saturday to face an 8-2 Tennessee team still chasing a place in the SEC Championship Game and the College Football Playoff.

LSU, meanwhile, enters at 6-4 overall and 3-4 in conference play, leaving little room for another setback.

The matchup also carries a personal dimension for Kiffin . He coached Tennessee in 2009 before leaving for USC after just one season, a departure that continues to irritate parts of the Volunteers fan base. His previous return to Neyland Stadium came in 2021 with Ole Miss, when fans threw mustard bottles and golf balls onto the field.

Kiffin isn't expecting a friendly reception this time either. He acknowledged that LSU has already encountered several hostile environments this season and suggested Knoxville would provide another intense atmosphere.

articles.title: UCLA cheerleader’s boyfriend steps into comments after girlfriend’s viral fame explodes
articles.standfirst: Sharlize True Trujillo has been one of the biggest beneficiaries of the unexpected attention
articles.summary: Sharlize True Trujillo has been one of the biggest beneficiaries of the unexpected attention
articles.body:
A three-second video has turned a UCLA Bruins cheerleader into one of the most talked-about personalities in college football, and her boyfriend has a message for the thousands of new followers suddenly flooding her social media accounts.

Sharlize True Trujillo, a 22-year-old member of the UCLA cheerleading squad, has become an unexpected internet sensation after a brief clip of three Bruins cheerleaders performing during last Friday night’s game against Illinois went viral across social media.

The slow-motion footage, which aired on FOX during UCLA’s home matchup, has accumulated millions of views, with fans quickly turning their attention to the cheerleaders. What lasted only a few seconds on television has since become a major social media moment.

One particularly popular post captured the reaction of college football fans, with a user joking that he was transferring to UCLA after watching the cheerleaders perform. That post alone generated an astonishing 30.3 million views and approximately 58,000 likes.

Trujillo has been one of the biggest beneficiaries of the unexpected attention. Her Instagram following has surged past 400,000, introducing her to an entirely new audience seemingly overnight. However, among all the new followers discovering the UCLA cheerleader, one person was particularly interested in making his presence known.

Sharlize True Trujillo’s boyfriend makes his feelings clear

As Trujillo’s popularity continues to explode online, her boyfriend, Jackson Dollinger, decided to enter the conversation with a short but unmistakable message. Commenting on one of her Instagram posts, Dollinger simply wrote: “That’s my girl.”

Trujillo responded with an equally affectionate message: “hi love.” It was a playful exchange, but one that quickly caught the attention of followers who have been keeping up with the cheerleader’s sudden rise to internet fame.

Interestingly, Dollinger is no stranger to having an audience of his own. The aspiring actor has more than 140,000 Instagram followers and is pursuing a career in Hollywood. The couple officially made their relationship public in September, when Trujillo shared a post celebrating time spent together with Dollinger and his family.

Dollinger also has an entertainment background that predates his relationship with the UCLA cheerleader . The former child actor has appeared in Disney Channel’s Sydney to the Max and the Apple TV drama series Life by Ella.

He enrolled at UCLA in 2025 and is now watching his girlfriend become one of the most recognizable college football cheerleaders on social media. With Trujillo’s following growing rapidly, Dollinger’s comment was a reminder that someone was already cheering her on long before the viral attention arrived.

UCLA’s undefeated season adds to the spotlight

While Trujillo and her boyfriend are generating plenty of attention online, the UCLA Bruins also have plenty to celebrate on the football field. UCLA improved to 10-0 after defeating Illinois at home last Friday, maintaining its perfect record and strengthening its position as one of the biggest stories of the 2026 college football season.

The Bruins have just two regular-season games remaining, beginning with a challenging road matchup against Michigan on Saturday . Kickoff is scheduled for 3:30 p.m. ET, with UCLA then returning home to close out its regular season against USC.

The attention surrounding Trujillo is an unexpected storyline during an already memorable season for the Bruins. A three-second television clip has generated tens of millions of views, pushed her Instagram following beyond 400,000 and even prompted her boyfriend to remind everyone that he is part of the picture.

articles.title: Arch Manning gets nominated for award and college football fans are enraged: "An abomination is being modest"
articles.standfirst: The Texas Longhorns quarterback has once again sparked discussion about bias due to his last name.
articles.summary: The Texas Longhorns quarterback has once again sparked discussion about bias due to his last name.
articles.body:
It's safe to say that the hype for Arch Manning got way too out of control early in his career. While many thought that hype was simply due to being related to Peyton and Eli Manning , Arch had also shown glimpses of greatness in limited stints with the Texas Longhorns .

But over the last two seasons, Manning has simply been too inconsistent. He's prone to turnovers and his throwing accuracy leaves a lot to be desired at times . In his second full season as the Longhorns' starter, Manning has shown some improvement, while also regressing in other areas from 2025. Statistically, this season is actually worse than the last one .

Arch Manning one of five finalists for top QB award in college football despite middling stats

Despite that, Manning was actually nominated for the Johnny United Golden Arm Award , which is given to the best quarterback in all of college football. Manning is one of five finalists, alongside Notre Dame's CJ Carr , Utah's Devon Dampier , Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker , and Georgia's Gunner Stockton .

College football fans were stunned to see Manning on the list, calling his selection an " abomination " and " truly astonishing ". There are way too many other quarterbacks across the nation who have played better football than Manning this season.

Among all quarterbacks in the nation, Manning ranks 56th in completion percentage, 36th in passing yards, 19th in touchdown passes, 52nd in QBR, has thrown the fourth-most interceptions, and taken the fourth-most sacks . There were more deserving players, even though Texas as a team has had a strong season overall with Manning at the helm.

articles.title: ESPN analyst delivers blunt message urging imperfect prospect Arch Manning to stay put for the 2027 NFL Draft
articles.standfirst: Texas and Manning are on track for the college playoffs with four consecutive wins
articles.summary: Texas and Manning are on track for the college playoffs with four consecutive wins
articles.body:
The Texas Longhorns have put together a strong 8-2 record through ten games of the 2026 college football season , sitting at No. 5 in the rankings with a realistic path to hosting a College Football Playoff matchup.

Along the way, Austin has celebrated signature victories over marquee opponents like Ohio State (24-23) , Tennessee (20-17) , Ole Miss (34-27) , and most recently a dramatic 22-21 road thriller against LSU in Baton Rouge.

Yet, despite the team’s collective success and Arch Manning earning a spot as one of five finalists for the Johnny Unitas Golden Arm Award , the 22-year-old quarterback’s individual stat line tells a much more uneven story.

Across 10 appearances this fall, Manning has completed 187 of 289 passes (64.7%) for 2,198 yards and 19 touchdowns , but his 10 interceptions, including three picks against LSU before delivering a game-winning four-yard touchdown pass with three seconds left, have raised serious questions about his readiness for the next level.

Booger McFarland Urges Arch Manning to Bypass the 2027 NFL Draft

That ongoing inconsistency prompted ESPN analyst Booger McFarland to deliver a blunt assessment during an appearance on The Dan Patrick Show urging the 6-foot-3, 225-pound signal-caller to hold off on entering the 2027 NFL Draft .

Labeling Manning an “imperfect prospect” whose on-field execution swings wildly from elite flashes to frustrating mistakes, McFarland noted that the massive expectations tied to the Manning family legacy only magnify his growing pains.

While praising his natural athleticism, arm strength, and pedigree, the former NFL defensive lineman argued that Manning simply has not put all the pieces together yet, a sentiment echoed by recent mock drafts that have dropped him entirely out of the first round behind rising quarterback prospects like Drew Mestemaker and CJ Carr .

Rather than jumping to the pros prematurely, McFarland suggested that Manning, who still holds a fifth year of college eligibility , should consider not only staying in college football for 2027, but potentially seeking a fresh offensive voice elsewhere after spending four years under Texas head coach Steve Sarkisian .

For his part, Manning has refused to tip his hand ahead of today’s home finale against the Arkansas Razorbacks . Although he confirmed he will participate in Senior Day ceremonies in Austin, the Longhorns star maintained that his focus remains strictly on finishing the current season strong rather than mapping out his future.

articles.title: Wild scene: College Football star chugs a beer mid-game to celebrate clutch interception
articles.standfirst: Holy Cross senior captain Adam Due unstrapped his helmet on the sideline and let the celebrations commence
articles.summary: Holy Cross senior captain Adam Due unstrapped his helmet on the sideline and let the celebrations commence
articles.body:
Most college football players cap off Senior Day with emotional hugs on the turf or a quiet walk to the locker room, but Holy Cross linebacker Adam Due chose a far more memorable send-off in Worcester, Massachusetts.

During Saturday’s regular-season finale against longtime Patriot League rival Fordham, the senior defensive leader delivered a game-clinching fourth-quarter interception and immediately celebrated with a spectator in the stands, creating one of the wildest viral highlights of the 2026 college football weekend.

Hosting the Rams at Fitton Field on November 21 in the annual Ram-Crusader Cup rivalry, Holy Cross clung to a 20-10 advantage with just under three minutes left on the clock.

Fordham had trimmed the deficit to 17-10 midway through the fourth quarter on a 12-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Gunnar Smith to Nodin Tracy , only for Crusaders kicker Owen Saraceno to answer with a 31-yard field goal.

Needing a quick score to stay alive, the Rams faced a decisive fourth-and-6 near midfield when Smith dropped back to throw his final pass of the afternoon.

Reading the play cleanly, Due stepped in front of the throw at the Holy Cross 45-yard line and hauled in the interception, returning it 28 yards to extinguish Fordham’s comeback hopes.

As he sprinted toward the home sideline with the crowd erupting, the Texas native unbuckled and pulled off his helmet, where a fan standing along the front row greeted him with an open, tall can of Modelo beer and poured it directly into his mouth.

Video of the spontaneous waterfall celebration spread rapidly across X, drawing comparisons to rare fan-assisted moments in college football such as Sacramento State running back Marcus Fulcher sipping a spectator’s drink during a 2022 FCS playoff game.

Behind Adam Due’s standout Senior Day and Holy Cross’s remarkable turnaround

Even before his viral sideline toast, Due had already turned in a dominant performance in his final collegiate appearance.

A four-year contributor for the Crusaders and an economics major who earned Patriot League Academic Honor Roll recognition as a sophomore, the senior captain anchored the Holy Cross defense with 13 tackles, a tackle for loss, a pass breakup, and a quarterback hurry, earning the inaugural Iron Major MVP award while finishing the 2026 campaign with 114 tackles and three interceptions.

The 20-10 triumph also put an exclamation point on one of the biggest turnarounds in the Football Championship Subdivision this fall.

After opening the season with four consecutive losses under head coach Dan Curran , Holy Cross rallied to win seven of its final eight contests, including seven straight conference matchups.

With Saturday’s victory, the program’s ninth win in its last 10 meetings against its New York rival, the Crusaders closed the regular season at 7-5 overall and 7-2 in Patriot League play, claiming sole possession of second place behind conference champion Lehigh.

For Due , walking off Fitton Field with the Ram-Crusader Cup secured and a viral celebration etched into program lore was the ultimate way to close his college career.

articles.title: Who could replace Deion "Coach Prime" Sanders at Colorado if he leaves the Buffaloes?
articles.standfirst: The football program would face one of the most consequential decisions in its recent history
articles.summary: The football program would face one of the most consequential decisions in its recent history
articles.body:
Deion Sanders’ future at Colorado is becoming an increasingly important question as the Buffaloes struggle through a disappointing season, raising the possibility that the program could be preparing for a new direction in 2027. Coach Prime arrived in Boulder with enormous expectations, national attention and the promise of restoring Colorado to relevance in college football. His arrival generated unprecedented excitement around the program, but sustaining that momentum has proven more difficult.

If Sanders decides that his time in Boulder has come to an end, or the university determines that a coaching change is necessary, Colorado would face one of the most consequential decisions in its recent football history.

Replacing Sanders would be no ordinary coaching search. His celebrity, recruiting connections and ability to attract national attention have made him a unique figure in college football. Finding someone capable of maintaining the program’s visibility while delivering more consistent results on the field would be a significant challenge.

Although there is no confirmed vacancy, six names stand out as potential candidates to monitor: Bryant Haines, Mike Shanahan, Lincoln Riley, Matt Entz, Jason Eck and Jay Hill.

1. Bryant Haines, Indiana defensive coordinator

Haines could be an attractive option if Colorado wants to move away from the celebrity-driven approach that defined the Sanders era and prioritize building a more consistent football operation.

The Indiana defensive coordinator has established himself as one of the most respected assistants in college football. He won the 2025 Broyles Award, presented annually to the nation’s top assistant coach, after helping Indiana produce an elite defensive unit during its national championship campaign.

His defenses have been particularly effective against the run, while his ability to develop players has helped Indiana become one of the country’s most competitive programs. Haines has also worked alongside Indiana head coach Curt Cignetti for several years, following him from James Madison to Bloomington . That experience has given him a front-row seat to one of the most impressive program transformations in recent college football history.

articles.title: Deion Sanders’ Colorado hot seat heats up again as Cincinnati loss kills momentum from Houston upset
articles.standfirst: Saturday’s 35-28 defeat at Nippert Stadium eliminated the Buffaloes from bowl contention and locked in a third losing season in four years under Coach Prime
articles.summary: Saturday’s 35-28 defeat at Nippert Stadium eliminated the Buffaloes from bowl contention and locked in a third losing season in four years under Coach Prime
articles.body:
Any optimism generated by Colorado’s recent upset victory over a ranked Houston squad evaporated quickly in Ohio on Saturday afternoon.

Falling 35-28 to Cincinnati , the Buffaloes dropped to 4-7 on the 2026 campaign, officially extinguishing their hopes of reaching the six-win threshold required for bowl eligibility and reigniting intense debate over head coach Deion Sanders ’ long-term future in Boulder.

The setback also guarantees that Sanders will finish with a losing record for the third time in four seasons at the helm of the program.

Aside from a breakthrough 9-4 finish and Alamo Bowl appearance in 2024, when future NFL players Shedeur Sanders and Heisman Trophy winner Travis Hunter anchored both sides of the ball, Colorado has struggled to string together consistent results under the Pro Football Hall of Famer, going 4-8 in his 2023 debut and 3-9 in 2025.

Ironically, Colorado’s offense moved the ball effectively throughout much of Saturday’s contest against a Bearcats team that entered the matchup riding a 12-game November losing streak.

The Buffaloes generated 433 total yards, highlighted by wide receiver Joseph Williams crossing the 1,000-yard receiving mark for the season and quarterback Isaac Wilson tossing three touchdown passes, yet self-inflicted wounds doomed them from the opening quarter.

Facing an early 14-point deficit, Colorado surrendered 225 rushing yards and committed four fatal turnovers, including three interceptions by Wilson.

“Early in the game, we didn't show up,” Sanders said. “We were still on the tarmac. Early turnovers crippled us.”

Taking responsibility afterward for a roster that has swung wildly from week to week, even after turning the starting quarterback job over from highly touted recruit Julian Lewis to Wilson earlier in the fall, Sanders pointed directly to his team’s inability to put all three phases together.

“We just have no true consistency,” Sanders said, per the Associated Press. “We don't know at this point how we're going to show up. Is the offense going to show up, the defense going to show up, the special teams. All of it's on me.”

Buyout math and road woes complicate Colorado’s offseason decision on Sanders

While frustration among supporters has mounted following another bowl-less autumn, removing Sanders would come with a steep financial price tag after Colorado rewarded him with a major contract extension in March 2025.

According to On3, the combination of dismal road results and a massive buyout leaves athletic officials weighing difficult choices over the coming weeks.

“Colorado and Deion Sanders are 1-10 on the road the last two years. With a buyout of approximately $25 million, it remains to be seen if the Buffaloes have the money to move on from Sanders . Sources do not expect any final decision on Sanders ’ future until the regular season concludes next week against UCF,” On3 reported.

That 1-10 road mark over the past two seasons underscores one of the sharpest criticisms of Sanders’ tenure: once the Buffaloes leave Folsom Field, competitive performances have been few and far between.

Although Sanders undeniably revitalized national television interest, university enrollment applications, and Boulder’s local economy upon his arrival in 2023, sustaining Big 12 competitiveness without generational stars has proved far more difficult.

Colorado closes out its 2026 schedule next Saturday, November 28, at home against UCF. While postseason play is already off the table, how fiercely the Buffaloes compete in their season finale could heavily influence whether university leadership commits tens of millions of dollars toward a coaching change or gives Sanders one more offseason to rebuild.

articles.title: Arch Manning talks about his future in college football or the NFL after his Senior Day walk
articles.standfirst: Manning still has a year of eligibility left, and he could earn more in the NIL market than he would as an NFL rookie
articles.summary: Manning still has a year of eligibility left, and he could earn more in the NIL market than he would as an NFL rookie
articles.body:
Since dropping back-to-back games to Oklahoma and Florida last month, the No. 5 Texas Longhorns (9-2, 6-2 SEC) have caught fire, rattling off five consecutive victories , capped by Saturday’s dominant 45-3 home blowout over the Arkansas Razorbacks .

Quarterback Arch Manning delivered one of his sharpest performances of the campaign at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium , completing 21 of 25 passes (84.0%) for 287 passing yards, two passing touchdowns, and a rushing score without a single turnover.

Now, Texas heads on the road to face rival Texas A&M in the Lone Star Showdown to close out the regular season, aiming to lock down a berth in the College Football Playoff . Notably, this marks the third and final year of the 12-team CFP format before the tournament expands to 24 teams beginning next season.

Arch Manning Keeps 2027 NFL Draft Plans Quiet

For Manning, Saturday’s lopsided win against Arkansas could very well have marked his final appearance inside DKR Stadium, given his status as a projected high pick ahead of next April’s 2027 NFL Draft.

Yet when pressed afterward about whether he had just played his final home snap in Austin, the redshirt junior kept his cards close to his vest. “I don’t know,” Manning told reporters postgame, admitting he remains genuinely undecided on whether to declare for the pros or exercise his fifth year of college eligibility.

Although he participated in Senior Day festivities alongside his family prior to kickoff, Manning still retains one final season of eligibility after redshirting as a true freshman back in 2023.

Many insiders around the program project a return to the Burnt Orange, though much will hinge on how far Manning and the Longhorns advance in the College Football Playoffs .

Financially, Manning sits in a rare position where he could theoretically earn more through NIL endorsements by remaining at Texas than he would on a rookie NFL contract. Staying on the Forty Acres would also offer a developmental runway closer to the traditional path his uncles Eli and Peyton Manning experienced, avoiding the instability that has plagued modern quarterback development in the transfer-portal era.

If Manning elects to return for 2027, he would walk back into an enviable offensive environment. While Texas may lose at least one weapon to the NFL Draft, the Longhorns stand a strong chance of returning most, if not all, of their explosive young receiving core featuring Emmett Mosley V, Ryan Wingo, Cam Coleman, and Jermaine Bishop Jr.

Even with changes expected in the backfield, Steve Sarkisian’s staff will inevitably restock the running back room with blue-chip talent.

Through 11 games in 2026, Manning has thrown for 2,485 yards, 21 touchdowns, and 10 interceptions on a 66.2 percent completion rate, adding 170 rushing yards and four scores on the ground, leaving plenty of intrigue around what his next chapter will hold.

articles.title: Viral UCLA cheerleaders spark fan frenzy as they gush over each other’s looks online
articles.standfirst: A brief sideline performance turned three Bruins cheerleaders into social media stars
articles.summary: A brief sideline performance turned three Bruins cheerleaders into social media stars
articles.body:
Three UCLA cheerleaders who captured the internet's attention with a brief sideline performance are enjoying an unexpected surge in popularity, with their latest Instagram exchanges giving fans another glimpse into the friendship behind their viral success.

Sharlize True Trujillo, Quillan Casem and Hayleigh Liu became social media sensations after an 18-second video showed them dancing during the Bruins ' college football game against Illinois earlier this month.

The footage spread rapidly on X after a supporter shared the clip alongside the caption "Transferring to UCLA," attracting more than 30 million views and introducing the trio to an audience extending far beyond college football.

Their sudden popularity has translated into growing Instagram followings, particularly for Trujillo , who was crowned Miss California 2026 in June and has emerged as the most recognizable member of the group.

The latest attention followed a series of photographs Trujillo shared before UCLA's game against Michigan on Saturday, celebrating the Bruins' impressive start to the season.

However, it was the reaction from her fellow cheerleaders that helped generate another wave of interest.

UCLA cheerleaders share affectionate messages

Trujillo uploaded several photographs ahead of Saturday's game, accompanying them with an enthusiastic message about UCLA's unbeaten record.

"It's gameday babyyyy," she wrote, adding: "still undefeated let's make that 11-0 UCLA."

Her teammates were among those who responded, with Liu leaving an enthusiastic compliment beneath the post. "So stunning omggggg," Liu commented.

Trujillo returned the praise immediately, replying: "@hayleighliu that's uuu star." Casem subsequently joined the conversation with another supportive message, writing: "Looking so good."

Trujillo responded with similar affection, telling her teammate: "@quillancasem love thank U beautiful star."

The exchanges offered a glimpse of the relationship between the three women, whose lives have changed considerably since their appearance in the widely circulated video.

While complimentary messages between friends are hardly unusual on Instagram, the attention surrounding the trio has made even their routine interactions a subject of interest among followers.

UCLA's viral stars enjoy growing popularity

Trujillo has been particularly active online since the video emerged, building an Instagram audience exceeding 400,000 followers.

Liu has also attracted considerable attention, with more than 50,000 followers, while Casem has approximately 13,000 despite posting less frequently than her teammates.

Their growing profiles reflect the increasing visibility of college cheerleaders in an era when a few seconds of footage can generate enormous social media exposure.

The online excitement has coincided with a memorable season for UCLA's football program, although the Bruins suffered a setback when Michigan ended their unbeaten run on Saturday.

UCLA now turns its attention to a regular-season finale against longtime rival USC on November 28, with kickoff scheduled for 3:30 p.m. ET on CBS.

The outcome will have implications for the Bruins ' postseason ambitions, but the three cheerleaders have already established their own following beyond the team's performances.
